blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of current front/three-quarter views: the design still reads as a plain ivory dress with a broad flat lavender front band and sparse buttons; the expected fencing-practice tailoring/detail is not convincingly present.
Arms-up and arm-cross images retain outlined elbow diamonds rather than integrated padded construction, plus angular shoulder/underarm folds.

Current crouch and seated images show shorts and large upper-thigh areas. Same-pose mesh coverage diagnostic measures crouch 31.0%/30.2% and sit 23.2%/22.4% on left/right upper thighs; higher forward hem thigh weights only modestly improved the prior 27.9%/27.3% and 19.2%/18.8%, so coverage remains unacceptable.
The prone render shows the overskirt collapsed into a broad, stiff irregular spread rather than controlled cloth drape; the prototype remains visually unacceptable in this pose.
Left and right views retain visibly faceted skirt folds and an abrupt waist-to-skirt transition, so the prototype does not read as finished sewn clothing.
The back render remains nearly featureless ivory with no clear waist adjustment or rear finishing detail.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
